shader.name: WRLDZ/UI/MenuCelSmoke
shader.rule: BUILD_PLAN D3: ONE new hand-written HLSL shader (no ShaderGraph / VFX Graph), in Always Included (§5.6)
route: SmokeField.cs splats every puff of one cel kind into its own R8 density (the alpha "over" union a = s + d (1 - s), bilinear sampling of the lobe sprite, sprite rect = the page's drawImage dest rect under the puff matrix) at densityScale of the stage
the glow source G0 = gaussian(M_low, sigma 9 stage px) computed on the CPU at the same 1/2 res on the thresholded low-res density (smoke_model route 4), a second R8

MenuCelSmoke samples the density bilinearly at full res and runs the page's SVG filter per pixel: M = sat(slope A + intercept); LIT = M (1 - M(p - off.lit)); MID = M M(p - off.mid); SLV = LIT (1 - LIT(p - off.sliver)) M; LINE = max over the (2r+1)^2 square (dilate, r = lineRadiusRaster) of M, times (1 - M); then merges over each other in order glow (glowOpacity G0), ink (LINE), fill (M), mid (MID), lit (LIT), sliver (sliverOpacity SLV) — premultiplied source-over
offsets are in stage px with y DOWN (canvas): p - off means the sample at (x - dx, y - dy); feOffset dx 8 dy 10 shifts the mask right / down
one quad per cel layer over the stage; layer alpha = the entrance factor e (anime_v61_fixup.js:37-47: the layer fades whole) x the layer's own alpha
shader.colorSpace: the palette is sRGB (color-interpolation-filters sRGB): WrldzAnimePalette sRGB -> Linear like every other WRLDZ colour

measured.note: levels of 255 on the cel layer alone (premultiplied); the max at 1/2 and 1/4 is single edge pixels flipping across the hard threshold (slope 26-80)

shader.decision: densityScale .5 (960 x 540 landscape, 540 x 1170 portrait): p99 <= 1.3 levels, the edge flips ~1-3 % of the smoke pixels; 1/4 doubles them. BUILD_PLAN §4 guessed 480 x 270.

kindNote: filter params read from the page's own <filter> elements (anime_v6.js:163-187); threshold = (.5 - intercept) / slope

dark0.note: row-major from the TOP row, 96 x 96 bytes = the sprite alpha (rgb is white); Texture2D rows run bottom-up: flip when loading

layers.what: the floor pool: 34 grey lobes (grey0 / grey1 alternating), alpha .8 e
the seep: 150 dark puffs (dark k = i % 4), alpha min(1, win(age) e (dark + .15) .82), lobe cap 54 k x .9

menu.order: drawn right after drawDoor (menu.js:665) on #fx: P1 layer z 21 (smoke_plate). The batch flushes at the next non-puff op: back first, then backHi (anime_v6.js:199). The omen black lightning is drawn right after it (anime_v61_cracks.js:625-626), over the mist.
menu.entrance: the cold open fades the whole layer by e = E.stone (fixup :41-47, while e < .999 and t <= 2); the boot handoff: k = e eOut(seg(t, 1.75, 2.6)) (:39); then the per-puff e = 1
menu.dread: v6.3 has no dread term in the seep or the pool (the additive ame glow puffs that carried SPEC §8.3 "smoke glow +30 %" are consumed): the smoke does not react to the ladder

whisper.what: the whisper's ink blot: 80 dark puffs (kind mass) on its own layer that fades as ONE (asLayer, fade = 1 - seg(k, .62, 1)); rng(seed 31 + 7), 5 R() per puff in order an, d1, d2, s, a; the 6 ame puffs are consumed (lighter); its 7 runes are the runes sprites (dread_<lay>.json runes)
whisper.call: drawInkBlot(g, inkAt, r = 56 k, seg(whisperU, -.05, 2.15), t, seed 3, {a: e, v41: true}) while -.05 < whisperU < 2.2 (menu_v41.js:68)

mouth.what: the omen's smoke mouth: 18 dark puffs (kind mass) + the black lips (blurred fill #020104 .96 k) + the wet depth; 10 + 9 ame puffs consumed
mouth.call: drawSmokeMouth(g, grinAt, 170 k, mo, t, -.28), mo = win(omenU, .3, .7, 1.3, 1.9) (menu_v41.js:69)

title.scaleRule: AN_SMOKE.scale 1.45 for t < 9.5, .85 after (anime_title_v6.js:27): each dest rect scaled about its centre
title.clock: t = origR(page t) (title.js:31 + anime_title_v6.js:27): the base clock, t - 2.6 after the origin freeze (7.4 s held 2.6 s)

clockCode.code:
const ORIG = { t0: 7.4, dur: 2.6 }; /* v5: the freeze holds 2.6 s — the lightning, the blood into his wound, his eyes opening (Lore v5 l.32-34) */
const origR = t => t <= ORIG.t0 ? t : t < ORIG.t0 + ORIG.dur ? ORIG.t0 : t - ORIG.dur;

title.draw: x = ((f.x + f.vx t) mod span + span) mod span - .75 f.s, span = W + 1.5 f.s; a = .9 f.a (.75 + .25 sin(.4 t + f.ph)) e, e = seg(t, 17.0, 17.6); dest (x - s/2, f.y - .3 s, s, .6 s) PUFF.dark[f.k]; then the title SWELL (anime_fix1_title.js:41-45, outermost): while a < .999 the rect scales about its centre by .3 + .7 eOut(clamp(a / .6)) and alpha -> min(1, 1.65 a); then the batcher scale .85 (t >= 9.5) about the centre
title.clip: P2 finding: the fog is clipped by Nut's part of the title (the P2 title stack orders it)
